description: PROPOSAL ONLY (#71). Each fixture names what it is checked against: answer (a Level 2 answer whose page may carry sources and bindings) or source_delivered, whether it is valid, and whether it uses an illustrative operation reserved for #85 or #86. check.py runs them.

fixtures.note: System Monitor: one metrics source every 2 s and four bound texts; after this answer no script runs while the page updates
Spotify: playback sampled every second, shown by bindings; the script hears only track changes
A Level 1 show section on a page: one HTTPS source, sampled once while visible, bound at /json; the script never sees the response
A Level 1 deliver section on a page: the response reaches the script once as source_delivered
A page has at most 8 sources
Source IDs are unique in the page (Host check)
A binding names a source of the same page (Host check)
clipboard.read is not offered at the source entry point
every is at least 1 s for any adapter; an adapter's own minimum (60 s for HTTPS, proposed) is a Host check
A source never answers from the response cache, so it takes no cache member
Formats are text, integer, decimal, percent, bytes and duration
A binding needs a pointer; the empty pointer names the whole result
Only text components bind; a field's value is the user's
The watched /track/id changed at sample 14
A failure is delivered when its category differs from the last delivered outcome
http.request's result with the parsed body as json
A delivery carries a result or a failure, not both
sequence numbers the sample
sequence starts at 1
A delivery names its page, which provenance checks
Failure categories are the listed ones
A Plugin never learns whether its view is visible
